verdict.rationale: Mastra's own model routing connects agents to 40+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and more) through one standard interface, which is the core of swapping providers without rewriting agent code. The evidence is a single README claim, repeated, with no detailed configuration docs. missing for 10: documentation showing how a model or provider is specified and swapped in agent config (e.g. model-string syntax), details on per-provider feature parity or fallbacks, and independent hands-on corroboration of switching providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent
